name: OPML Note Import
changes: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
Decodes an outline file with the encoding that its XML declaration names.
Adds a note level from 1 to 6.
changes_user: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
Outlines in Latin-1 or another declared encoding now keep their accented characters.
Choose a note level from 1 to 6 to make one note for each item deeper in the outline.
tip: Choose level 2 or higher when one root item holds the whole outline.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. OPML Note Import is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for moving your notes into Obsidian with it.
